display.purpose: The hero headline only, the page's main graphic element, at normal width (wdth 100).

statement.purpose: The About sentence lit by the scroll (35 to 55px, wdth 75).

curtain.purpose: The new language's name on the language switch panel, white on Signal Blue.

title.purpose: Project names, card titles, case study subsections (h3), wdth 85.

voice.purpose: Instrument Serif italic 400, about 1.14x the sans size: only the curious half of a display sentence (hero headline, About statement), never a paragraph, label or button.

body.purpose: All running text, never wider than 53ch (about 75 characters a line).

micro.purpose: Code tags, small indicators, header name subline.

code.purpose: System monospace stack, used only inside code in blog posts.

shadows.name: hard-lift
shadows.purpose: Hard 4px offset in ink on primary button hover, the case study next-project card hover and the desktop blog index project preview card; the single shadow in the system.

motion.name: step-state
motion.purpose: Small feedback (hover, focus, press, notices) moves in steps(2-4) over 80-240ms.

motion.name: ease-cover
motion.purpose: Surfaces that cover or uncover the page: theme circle reveal (0.7s), language curtain (0.5s), whole-sheet page rise (0.5s).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a section; lifts onto a hard ink shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--fg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms steps(2), box-shadow 120ms steps(2); } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--accent, #0058b8); background: var(--accent, #0058b8); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-4px, -4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--fg, #1d1d1c); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0058b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action next to the primary one: ink outline, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--fg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; transition: transform 120ms steps(2); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0058b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Repository Tag
components.description: A link to a GitHub repository: pixel mark and name in a hard-edged tag that inverts on hover.
components.html: dashboard-tesi
components.css: .ds-repo-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid var(--fg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms steps(2), color 120ms steps(2), transform 120ms steps(2); } .ds-repo-tag:hover { background: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--bg, #dedede); } .ds-repo-tag:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-repo-tag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0058b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation Link
components.description: Header link whose hover and active states share one hard 2px underline drawn in steps.
components.html: WorkExperience
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 8px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 120ms steps(4); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0058b8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Band
components.description: A full-bleed section band that re-points the text, link and focus colours for its content.

components.css: .ds-band-ink { --fg: var(--band-ink-fg, #f2f2f2); --link: var(--band-ink-link, #9ccaff); --focus: var(--band-ink-link, #9ccaff); background: var(--band-ink-bg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--fg); padding: 64px 32px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-band-ink h2 { margin: 0 0 24px; font-size: 2.747rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 85; } .ds-band-ink p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 53ch; } .ds-band-ink a { color: var(--link); text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-band-ink a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A sober page, a game inside. What a recruiter meets first is plain and calm: a concrete grey page, ink text in one sans family, one Signal Blue, everything snapped to an 8px grid. Under that surface the site plays: a field of pastel pixels in the hero, a voxel moai that breathes and blows gum, side quests kept like items in an inventory, a player card behind the Konami code. The calm is what makes the play read as craft rather than noise.

Density is low and text-first. Sections alternate with full-bleed bands (pastel, lavender, ink) that change the mood without changing the type. Edges are hard and stepped, never soft: no rounded cards, no blur, no decorative gradients. Boldness is spent on a few named living objects; everything else stays out of their way.
keyCharacteristics: One family, Instrument Sans Variable, with width doing the expressive work (condensed headings, full-width body), plus one italic serif voice, Instrument Serif, for the curious half of a display sentence.
One accent, Signal Blue, for actions, focus and pixels; pastels only in decoration.
8px grid for every space, icon, cell and image size.
Stepped shapes and `steps()` transitions instead of curves.
A light and a dark theme, equal in care, both WCAG 2.2 AA.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Selected text is ink (`#1d1d1c`) on Pixel Peach (`#ffb88f`), about 10:1, in both themes and on every band (`--selection-bg`, `--selection-fg`). Peach is the one pastel no band sits on, so a selection never vanishes into its background.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: No green anywhere: not for success, not in syntax colours, not as a pastel. The brand is greys, the blue family, lavender and peach.

rules.name: The Silent Pastel Rule
rules.body: The `pixel-*` colours never carry text or a control's state; text on a pastel band uses that band's own ink tokens.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Every new colour ships with a light and a dark value, both checked for AA; a token that is light in one theme can turn black in the other.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, eyebrows, monospace metadata, middle-dot meta strings, arrows appended to links, or a single accented word in a headline. Two exceptions: the full name beside the moai mark in the header, in tracked capitals on two lines; and the pixel arrow after the giant contact title, which is the title's own action (it links to LinkedIn), not a decoration on a link.

rules.name: The Width Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and the `wdth` axis at weight 600; don't add weights for emphasis. The one second face is the `voice` role: the sans is the method, the italic serif is the curiosity.

rules.name: The Eight Rule
rules.body: Every space, icon, cell and image dimension is a multiple of 8px.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: No soft drop shadows. A shadow, where one exists, is a solid offset with no blur.

rules.name: The Stepped Edge Rule
rules.body: If a shape would be smooth, draw it in pixels instead.

dos: Do read colours through the CSS custom properties (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--accent`, `--link`, band tokens); never hard-code a hex in a component.
Do keep every space and size on the 8px scale.
Do use `steps()` for state transitions on buttons and tags.

Do let surfaces that cover or uncover the page (language curtain, theme circle, page change) glide on `--ease-cover`; on a page change the header stays put and the new page rises from the bottom edge in 0.5s as a whole sheet (`translate`, not a `clip-path` window) while the old one dims (issue #555). Only the header and the fixed pixel cursor (and its arrow) have a `view-transition-name` (issue #560): a named title would slide across the page.
Do reuse `PixelDissolve`, the seams and the thread before inventing a new transition.
Do put `appDepixelate` on any new photo, and show a project's pixel sprite in the 3:2 frame when it has no screenshot.
Do list things as full-width rows under a 1px rule, with body text and lists within `--measure` (including the stepped case study diagram rows in `case-diagram.scss`, issue #645).
Do give secondary actions the primary button's 48px height and type size.
Do check every change at 1280px and 390px, in both themes.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, soft drop shadows, blur or gradients as decoration.
Don't set text in a `pixel-*` colour.
Don't use all-caps labels, eyebrows, monospace metadata, middle-dot meta strings or arrows appended to links.
Don't add another typeface or extra weights for emphasis; Instrument Serif italic stays in the voice role, never in a paragraph, label or button.
Don't lay things out as a row of three identical tiles.
Don't let an entrance overshoot (`back.out`, elastic, bounce).
Don't write aphorisms after a colon, triads, idioms, or claims CI does not enforce (see Copy voice in edm-style).
Don't type straight apostrophes or quotes in visible copy: `’` and `“…”` (issue #583).
Don't add hover-only behaviour on phones, or block vertical scrolling on anything swipeable.
